label: Tailscale
description: Manage tailnet devices, subnet routes, DNS, users and key metadata

operations.name: list_devices
operations.description: List all devices in the tailnet, without pagination.

operations.name: get_device
operations.description: Get a device's details.

operations.name: delete_device
operations.description: Remove a device from its tailnet.

operations.name: expire_device_key
operations.description: Expire the device's node key, requiring reauthentication.

operations.name: list_device_routes
operations.description: Read advertised and enabled subnet routes.

operations.name: set_device_routes
operations.description: Replace enabled routes; an empty list disables all routes.

operations.name: authorize_device
operations.description: Authorize or deauthorize a device.

operations.name: set_device_name
operations.description: Set a device's MagicDNS name, or reset it from its OS hostname.

operations.name: set_device_tags
operations.description: Replace the complete list of identity tags on a device.

operations.name: update_device_key
operations.description: Enable or disable device key expiry.

operations.name: list_dns_nameservers
operations.description: Read the global DNS nameservers.

operations.name: set_dns_nameservers
operations.description: Replace global DNS nameservers; [] removes them.

operations.name: get_dns_preferences
operations.description: Read whether MagicDNS is enabled.

operations.name: set_dns_preferences
operations.description: Enable or disable MagicDNS.

operations.name: list_dns_search_paths
operations.description: Read DNS search domains.

operations.name: set_dns_search_paths
operations.description: Replace DNS search domains; [] removes them.

operations.name: list_keys
operations.description: List key metadata; secret key material is omitted.

operations.name: get_key
operations.description: Read metadata for an auth key or trust credential.

operations.name: delete_key
operations.description: Revoke an auth key or trust credential.

operations.name: list_users
operations.description: List tailnet users with optional relation and role filters.

operations.name: get_user
operations.description: Get a tailnet user's details.
